name: Linear
whatYouLose: Exceptionally fast multiplayer sync and offline behavior
Deep issue workflows, integrations, roadmaps, and triage automation
Years of interaction and keyboard-shortcut refinement
prompt: Build a keyboard-first issue tracker for one software team. Support projects, cycles, statuses, priorities, labels, assignees, issue relations, comments, and markdown descriptions. Include a fast command menu, list and board views, filters encoded in the URL, issue templates, activity history, CSV import/export, and a minimal GitHub webhook that links commits to issue keys. Use Astro SSR, SQLite full-text search, and small vanilla JavaScript enhancements. Add migrations, seed data, accessibility checks, and tests.
notes: A calm issue tracker for one opinionated workflow is buildable. Linear's speed, sync, and breadth remain the moat.
